# FilePreview

Previews files in a full-window viewer: images, video, audio and text (code, JSON, Markdown, logs) are shown
directly; other files show a card with their name and size, and can be shown in your own way with `render` (such
as PDF with a PDF library). Files are switched with `←` / `→`, the side buttons or by swiping. Use
`FilePreview.Inline` for a preview inside the page.

Text files are read up to their first 256 KB; JSON is formatted. The background of images uses the neutral viewer
tokens, like Lightbox, so it does not change how the colors of images are perceived; text is shown on a sheet in
the colors of the theme.

**Interaction**: a modal dialog. When it opens, focus moves to "Close"; `Esc` closes it, `←` / `→` switch files,
`+` / `-` zoom images and `0` fits them again; `Tab` stays inside the preview and focus returns to the opener
after closing. Images zoom with the wheel or a pinch around the pointer, a double click (or double tap) switches
between fitting the window and the actual size, and zoomed images are dragged to move them. Dragging a file
sideways switches to the next one, dragging it up or down closes the preview (the background fades with the
distance), and clicking outside the file closes it too. While an image is shown and the pointer rests, the
toolbar fades away; moving the pointer brings it back.

**Motion**: an image opened from a thumbnail (the element that was pressed, or one with the same
`data-vl-preview-id`, such as the tiles of ImageGrid) grows out of it along the spring and flies back into it when
closing; otherwise the preview fades in and the image grows into place once loaded. Switching files slides them
along a track; gestures follow the finger and settle along the spring when released, and every motion can be
interrupted.

**Category**: Media · **Common uses**: Previewing attachments and uploaded files, viewing images in a gallery, checking logs and data files

## Import

```ts
import { FilePreview } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Open any file of a list: images open from their tile and can be zoomed (wheel, double click, `+` / `-`), text and
data files are shown on a sheet, and the PDF, which the browser cannot show here, gets a card. Switch with `←` /
`→` or by dragging sideways; drag up or down to close.

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { FilePreview, Icon, ImageGrid } from 'vellum-ui'
import { DemoFrame } from './_frame.tsx'

interface SampleFile {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly src?: string
  readonly type?: string
  readonly size?: number
  readonly content?: string
}

function samplePhoto(width: number, height: number, hue: number): string {
  const sky = `oklch(0.82 0.07 ${hue})`
  const hill = `oklch(0.52 0.08 ${(hue + 60) % 360})`
  const sun = `oklch(0.9 0.1 ${(hue + 200) % 360})`
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${width}" height="${height}" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}"><rect width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="${sky}"/><circle cx="${width * 0.7}" cy="${height * 0.3}" r="${Math.min(width, height) * 0.12}" fill="${sun}"/><path d="M0 ${height * 0.72} Q${width * 0.3} ${height * 0.5} ${width * 0.55} ${height * 0.68} T${width} ${height * 0.62} V${height} H0Z" fill="${hill}"/></svg>`
  return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`
}

function sampleFiles(): SampleFile[] {
  const log = Array.from(
    { length: 40 },
    (_, i) =>
      `2026-11-14T09:${String(10 + Math.floor(i / 4)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String((i * 7) % 60).padStart(2, '0')}Z ${i % 9 === 4 ? 'WARN ' : 'INFO '} worker-${(i % 3) + 1} processed batch ${1200 + i} in ${40 + ((i * 13) % 90)} ms`,
  ).join('\n')
  return [
    { id: 'f-1', name: 'harbor-morning.png', src: samplePhoto(1600, 1000, 230), size: 482_113 },
    { id: 'f-2', name: 'meadow.png', src: samplePhoto(900, 1200, 130), size: 356_902 },
    {
      id: 'f-3',
      name: 'release-notes.md',
      content:
        '# Release notes\n\nThis release improves **sync** and adds two settings.\n\n## Changes\n\n- Faster initial sync for large projects\n- New setting: *Pause sync on metered networks*\n- Fixed a crash when a file name contained `#`\n\n> Upgrade at your convenience; no migration is needed.\n',
    },
    {
      id: 'f-4',
      name: 'settings.json',
      content:
        '{"theme":"system","sync":{"enabled":true,"interval":300,"paused":false},"recent":["Atlas","Beacon","Comet"]}',
    },
    { id: 'f-5', name: 'worker.log', content: log },
    { id: 'f-6', name: 'desert.png', src: samplePhoto(1400, 900, 40), size: 401_550 },
    { id: 'f-7', name: 'quarterly-report.pdf', type: 'application/pdf', size: 2_340_112 },
  ]
}

export function Basic() {
  const files = useMemo(() => sampleFiles(), [])
  const [index, setIndex] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const tiles = files.map((file) => ({
    id: file.id,
    src: file.src ?? '',
    alt: file.name,
    caption: file.name,
    fallback: <Icon name={file.name.endsWith('.pdf') ? 'file' : 'file-text'} size={28} />,
  }))
  return (
    <DemoFrame>
      <ImageGrid items={tiles} onOpen={(i) => setIndex(i)} />
      <FilePreview
        open={index !== null}
        items={files}
        index={index ?? 0}
        onIndexChange={setIndex}
        onClose={() => setIndex(null)}
      />
    </DemoFrame>
  )
}
```

`DemoFrame` is only a fixed-height container of the examples; in a page, put the component in `Page fill` or `Panel fill`.

## Variants

### Inline preview

`FilePreview.Inline` shows the selected file next to the list and fills the height of its parent. Zoom images with
a double click or `Ctrl` + wheel; "Full screen" opens the full-window preview, and the image flies out of the
area and back.

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { Box, FilePreview, type FilePreviewItem, ListItem, Splitter, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'
import { DemoFrame } from './_frame.tsx'

interface SampleFile {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly src?: string
  readonly type?: string
  readonly size?: number
  readonly content?: string
}

function samplePhoto(width: number, height: number, hue: number): string {
  const sky = `oklch(0.82 0.07 ${hue})`
  const hill = `oklch(0.52 0.08 ${(hue + 60) % 360})`
  const sun = `oklch(0.9 0.1 ${(hue + 200) % 360})`

  return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`
}

function sampleFiles(): SampleFile[] {
  const log = Array.from(
    { length: 40 },
    (_, i) =>
      `2026-11-14T09:${String(10 + Math.floor(i / 4)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String((i * 7) % 60).padStart(2, '0')}Z ${i % 9 === 4 ? 'WARN ' : 'INFO '} worker-${(i % 3) + 1} processed batch ${1200 + i} in ${40 + ((i * 13) % 90)} ms`,
  ).join('\n')
  return [
    { id: 'f-1', name: 'harbor-morning.png', src: samplePhoto(1600, 1000, 230), size: 482_113 },
    { id: 'f-2', name: 'meadow.png', src: samplePhoto(900, 1200, 130), size: 356_902 },
    {
      id: 'f-3',
      name: 'release-notes.md',
      content:
        '# Release notes\n\nThis release improves **sync** and adds two settings.\n\n## Changes\n\n- Faster initial sync for large projects\n- New setting: *Pause sync on metered networks*\n- Fixed a crash when a file name contained `#`\n\n> Upgrade at your convenience; no migration is needed.\n',
    },
    {
      id: 'f-4',
      name: 'settings.json',
      content:
        '{"theme":"system","sync":{"enabled":true,"interval":300,"paused":false},"recent":["Atlas","Beacon","Comet"]}',
    },
    { id: 'f-5', name: 'worker.log', content: log },
    { id: 'f-6', name: 'desert.png', src: samplePhoto(1400, 900, 40), size: 401_550 },
    { id: 'f-7', name: 'quarterly-report.pdf', type: 'application/pdf', size: 2_340_112 },
  ]
}

export function Inline() {
  const files = useMemo(() => sampleFiles(), [])
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<FilePreviewItem | null>(files[0] ?? null)
  return (
    <DemoFrame>
      <Splitter defaultSize={220} min={160} max={320} aria-label="Resize the file list">
        <Box surface="canvas" padding={2} grow>
          <Stack gap={1}>
            {files.map((file) => (
              <ListItem
                key={file.id}
                density="compact"
                title={file.name}
                selected={selected?.id === file.id}
                onClick={() => setSelected(file)}
              />
            ))}
          </Stack>
        </Box>
        <Box padding={3} grow>
          <FilePreview.Inline item={selected} />
        </Box>
      </Splitter>
    </DemoFrame>
  )
}
```

`DemoFrame` is only a fixed-height container of the examples; in a page, put the component in `Page fill` or `Panel fill`.

## Advanced

### Downloads, actions and your own renderer

`onDownload` adds a "Download" button (here with a link that has `download`); `actions` adds your own buttons; and
`render` shows file types that the preview does not support, here a PDF as a summary card. Return `undefined` from
`render` to keep the built-in preview.

```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Box,
  FilePreview,
  type FilePreviewItem,
  IconButton,
  ListItem,
  Stack,
  Text,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface SampleFile {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly src?: string
  readonly type?: string
  readonly size?: number
  readonly content?: string
}

function samplePhoto(width: number, height: number, hue: number): string {
  const sky = `oklch(0.82 0.07 ${hue})`
  const hill = `oklch(0.52 0.08 ${(hue + 60) % 360})`
  const sun = `oklch(0.9 0.1 ${(hue + 200) % 360})`
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${width}" height="${height}" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}"><rect width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="${sky}"/><circle cx="${width * 0.7}" cy="${height * 0.3}" r="${Math.min(width, height) * 0.12}" fill="${sun}"/><path d="M0 ${height * 0.72} Q${width * 0.3} ${height * 0.5} ${width * 0.55} ${height * 0.68} T${width} ${height * 0.62} V${height} H0Z" fill="${hill}"/></svg>`
  return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`
}

function sampleFiles(): SampleFile[] {
  const log = Array.from(
    { length: 40 },
    (_, i) =>
      `2026-11-14T09:${String(10 + Math.floor(i / 4)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String((i * 7) % 60).padStart(2, '0')}Z ${i % 9 === 4 ? 'WARN ' : 'INFO '} worker-${(i % 3) + 1} processed batch ${1200 + i} in ${40 + ((i * 13) % 90)} ms`,
  ).join('\n')
  return [
    { id: 'f-1', name: 'harbor-morning.png', src: samplePhoto(1600, 1000, 230), size: 482_113 },
    { id: 'f-2', name: 'meadow.png', src: samplePhoto(900, 1200, 130), size: 356_902 },
    {
      id: 'f-3',
      name: 'release-notes.md',
      content:
        '# Release notes\n\nThis release improves **sync** and adds two settings.\n\n## Changes\n\n- Faster initial sync for large projects\n- New setting: *Pause sync on metered networks*\n- Fixed a crash when a file name contained `#`\n\n> Upgrade at your convenience; no migration is needed.\n',
    },
    {
      id: 'f-4',
      name: 'settings.json',
      content:
        '{"theme":"system","sync":{"enabled":true,"interval":300,"paused":false},"recent":["Atlas","Beacon","Comet"]}',
    },
    { id: 'f-5', name: 'worker.log', content: log },
    { id: 'f-6', name: 'desert.png', src: samplePhoto(1400, 900, 40), size: 401_550 },
    { id: 'f-7', name: 'quarterly-report.pdf', type: 'application/pdf', size: 2_340_112 },
  ]
}

export function Custom() {
  const files = useMemo(() => sampleFiles(), [])
  const [index, setIndex] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const download = (file: FilePreviewItem) => {
    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href =
      file.src ?? `data:text/plain;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(file.content ?? '')}`
    link.download = file.name
    link.click()
  }
  return (
    <>
      <Stack gap={1}>
        {files.map((file, i) => (
          <ListItem key={file.id} density="compact" title={file.name} onClick={() => setIndex(i)} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <FilePreview
        open={index !== null}
        items={files}
        index={index ?? 0}
        onIndexChange={setIndex}
        onClose={() => setIndex(null)}
        onDownload={download}
        actions={(file) => (
          <IconButton
            icon="share"
            label="Copy link"
            onClick={() => navigator.clipboard?.writeText(file.name)}
          />
        )}
        render={(file) =>
          file.type === 'application/pdf' ? (
            <Box surface="surface" padding={6} radius="xl">
              <Stack gap={2}>
                <Text weight="semibold">{file.name}</Text>
                <Text tone="secondary">
                  Quarterly report, 12 pages. Open it in your PDF reader to see the charts.
                </Text>
              </Stack>
            </Box>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the preview is open. | — | Yes |
| `items` | `readonly FilePreviewItem[]` | Files to switch between. | — | Yes |
| `index` | `number` | Index of the file shown (controlled). | — | Yes |
| `onIndexChange` | `(index: number) => void` | Called when switching to another file; without it, the files cannot be switched. | — | No |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | Called when closing (`Esc`, the close button, clicking outside the file, dragging it away). | — | Yes |
| `stage` | `'mid' \| 'dark' \| 'black'` | Fixed viewer background; when omitted, the viewer background from ThemeProvider is used and can be changed in the toolbar. | — | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the dialog; "File preview" when omitted. | — | No |
| `testId` | `string` | Test id, rendered as `data-testid` on the dialog. | — | No |
| `actions` | `(item: FilePreviewItem) => ReactNode` | Your own buttons in the toolbar for the file shown, such as "Share" or "Show in folder"; use IconButton. | — | No |
| `onDownload` | `(item: FilePreviewItem) => void` | Shows a "Download" button and is called when it is pressed; the application decides how to save the file (a link with `download` in the browser, a save dialog in a desktop client). No button when omitted. | — | No |
| `render` | `(item: FilePreviewItem) => ReactNode` | Shows a file in your own way, such as PDF with a PDF library: return the content, or `undefined` to use the built-in preview. The content fills the preview area; gestures (swiping, dragging to close) do not start on it. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## FilePreview.Inline

The preview as an area of the page, such as the right pane of a file list: a header with the file name, size
and buttons, and the file below it, filling the height of the parent. Images can be zoomed with a pinch,
`Ctrl` + wheel or a double click, and dragged when zoomed; "Full screen" opens the full-window preview.

### Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | `FilePreviewItem \| null` | The file shown; `null` shows "No file selected". | — | Yes |
| `expandable` | `boolean` | Shows a "Full screen" button that opens the file in the full-window preview (images fly out of the area and back). | `true` | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the area; the file name when omitted. | — | No |
| `testId` | `string` | Test id, rendered as `data-testid`. | — | No |
| `actions` | `(item: FilePreviewItem) => ReactNode` | Your own buttons in the toolbar for the file shown, such as "Share" or "Show in folder"; use IconButton. | — | No |
| `onDownload` | `(item: FilePreviewItem) => void` | Shows a "Download" button and is called when it is pressed; the application decides how to save the file (a link with `download` in the browser, a save dialog in a desktop client). No button when omitted. | — | No |
| `render` | `(item: FilePreviewItem) => ReactNode` | Shows a file in your own way, such as PDF with a PDF library: return the content, or `undefined` to use the built-in preview. The content fills the preview area; gestures (swiping, dragging to close) do not start on it. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### FilePreviewItem

A file shown by FilePreview. Give `src` (an address) or `file` (a `File` or `Blob` in memory); text that is already
in memory can be given as `content`.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Unique ID. Thumbnails with the same ID in `data-vl-preview-id` (the tiles of ImageGrid have it) are where images fly in from and back to. | — | Yes |
| `name` | `string` | File name, shown in the toolbar; its extension also decides how the file is shown when `type` is omitted. | — | Yes |
| `src` | `string` | Address of the file. | — | No |
| `file` | `Blob` | The file in memory (such as a file the user picked); an object URL is created for it while it is shown and released afterwards. | — | No |
| `type` | `string` | MIME type, such as `image/png`; taken from `file`, or guessed from the extension of `name`, when omitted. | — | No |
| `size` | `number` | Size in bytes, shown in the toolbar; taken from `file` when omitted. | — | No |
| `content` | `string` | The text of a text file, when it is already in memory (such as a response body); used instead of loading `src`. | — | No |
| `alt` | `string` | Alternative text of an image, read by screen readers; the file name when omitted. | — | No |
